descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Probability and Predictions (D2.1-D2.2)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on probability framed around Lucky Lou and Maybe Mae. Children use the 5-word likelihood scale, make predictions, test across two populations, and predict mean and mode.
long_description: Lucky Lou and Maybe Mae return for Grade 3 likelihood! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 3 unit covers both D2 expectations (D2.1, D2.2) building on G1/G2 likelihood units. Day 1 introduces the FIVE-WORD scale (impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely, certain). Day 2 uses scale words to make predictions and decisions. Day 3 introduces TWO-POPULATION testing. Day 4 introduces predicting MEAN and MODE across populations. Day 5 closes with a Big Predict Capstone integrating both expectations. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-3 trap: binary thinking, bare-guess, single-group, no-test, bare-conclusion), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 2-row summative rubric, and Junior Predictor G3 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day probability unit (D2.1-D2.2).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on probability investigation with character-driven prediction frame, structured pair work, and progressive complexity from G1/G2 likelihood units.
